findings.evidence: `roadmap/TauCetiRoadmap/AnalyticToricGeometry/README.md:148-150` explicitly requires preservation under “faces, intersections, products, injective integral maps, and lattice equivalences”; grep of the new file finds only `of_isFaceOf` and no theorem consuming two arbitrary toric cones.
findings.fix: First supply the missing rational-polyhedral intersection/Minkowski–Weyl prerequisite, then prove `IsLatticeRational i (σ ⊓ τ)` and `IsToricCone i (σ ⊓ τ)` for arbitrary rational/toric cones.
findings.issue: `IsToricCone.of_isFaceOf` only proves toricity of intersections already assumed to be faces; it does not establish preservation under arbitrary intersections as required by Layer 0 item 2.

summary: The implementation substitutes the face-of case for the roadmap’s required preservation under arbitrary intersections, leaving the advertised algebraic supplier incomplete.
